description: This Java interface defines a service for managing device connection information within the Eclipse Hono framework. It includes methods to set and retrieve the last gateway that acted on behalf of a device, utilizing asynchronous handlers and OpenTracing spans.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionService
classes.description: An interface providing methods to record and retrieve the last known gateway acting on behalf of a device.

methods.name: setLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Sets the last gateway that acted on behalf of a specific device, identified by tenantId and deviceId, and associates it with a provided span for tracing.

methods.name: getLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the last gateway that acted on behalf of a specific device, invoking the result handler with the result including appropriate HTTP status semantics.
